hits.text:
Looks like this is going to be a week of Apple press releases, starting today with the new OLED iPad Mini

- 8.5" OLED display
- A20 Pro chip
- "Acoustic display" instead of speaker grilles
- IP67 rating
- N1 and C2 chips
- Starting at $699 (+$200 from last gen)

My take: WAY https://t.co/MesE607wvy
